parameters.name: client_cert
parameters.description: The client certificate file path. If not specified, it defaults to $HOME/.config/lxc/client.crt.

parameters.name: client_key
parameters.description: The client certificate key file path. If not specified, it defaults to $HOME/.config/lxc/client.key.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: The config for the project (for example {"features.profiles": "true"}). See https://documentation.ubuntu.com/lxd/en/latest/api/#/projects/project_get. If the project already exists and its “config” value in metadata obtained from GET /1.0/projects/<name> https://documentation.ubuntu.com/lxd/en/latest/api/#/projects/project_get are different, then this module tries to apply the configurations https://documentation.ubuntu.com/lxd/en/latest/api/#/projects/project_put.

parameters.name: merge_project
parameters.description: Merge the configuration of the present project with the new desired configuration, instead of replacing it. If configuration is the same after merged, no change is made. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: new_name
parameters.description: A new name of a project. If this parameter is specified a project is renamed to this name. See https://documentation.ubuntu.com/lxd/en/latest/api/#/projects/project_post.

parameters.name: snap_url
parameters.description: The Unix domain socket path when LXD is installed by snap package manager. Default: "unix:/var/snap/lxd/common/lxd/unix.socket"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Define the state of a project. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: trust_password
parameters.description: The client trusted password. You need to set this password on the LXD server before running this module using the following command: lxc config set core.trust_password <some random password> See https://www.stgraber.org/2016/04/18/lxd-api-direct-interaction/. If trust_password is set, this module send a request for authentication before sending any requests.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The Unix domain socket path or the https URL for the LXD server. Default: "unix:/var/lib/lxd/unix.socket"

examples:
# An example for creating a project
- hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  tasks:
    - name: Create a project
      community.general.lxd_project:
        name: ansible-test-project
        state: present
        config: {}
        description: my new project

# An example for renaming a project
- hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  tasks:
    - name: Rename ansible-test-project to ansible-test-project-new-name
      community.general.lxd_project:
        name: ansible-test-project
        new_name: ansible-test-project-new-name
        state: present
        config: {}
        description: my new project

return_values.name: actions
return_values.description: List of actions performed for the project. Returned: success Sample: ["create"]

return_values.name: logs
return_values.description: The logs of requests and responses. Returned: when ansible-playbook is invoked with -vvvv.

return_values.name: request
return_values.description: HTTP request sent to LXD server. Returned: success

return_values.name: json
return_values.description: JSON body of HTTP request. Returned: success Sample: "(too long to be placed here)"

return_values.name: method
return_values.description: Method of HTTP request. Returned: success Sample: "GET"

return_values.name: timeout
return_values.description: Timeout of HTTP request, null if unset. Returned: success

return_values.name: url
return_values.description: URL path of HTTP request. Returned: success Sample: "/1.0/projects/test-project"

return_values.name: response
return_values.description: HTTP response received from LXD server. Returned: success

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: Type of actions performed, currently only sent request. Returned: success Sample: "sent request"

return_values.name: old_state
return_values.description: The old state of the project. Returned: success Sample: "absent"
